ValidationRule.description: Requires that if a PG is related to the deal, their FICO must be entered on the Credit Review prior to Approval.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( ISCHANGED(Status__c), ISPICKVAL(Status__c, 'Approved'), OR( AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PG1__c)), ISBLANK(PG_1_EQF_Score__c), ISBLANK(PG_1_EXP_Score__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PG2__c)), ISBLANK(PG_2_EQF_Score__c), ISBLANK(PG_2_EXP_Score__c) ), AND( NOT(ISBLANK(PG3__c)), ISBLANK(PG_3_EQF_Score__c), ISBLANK(PG_3_EXP_Score__c) ) ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: FICO must be entered for each Guarantor before Approval can be issued
